name: Coastal plant forms
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Exactly6 whole plants in separate large cells. Complete root/trunk-to-crown forms; smaller coherent leaf/bark/canopy or side inset, no humans, soil pedestals, attached architecture. Distinct species silhouettes, realistic branching and restrained local natural palette. Do not turn plants into disconnected bouquets. Botanical labels are concept names, not validated specimens. Title "T03-FLORA-001 — Coastal plant forms". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Distinct missing coastal plants, not ordinary reeds or palace roses. Natural green/tan coastal leaves and root/holdfast forms, no metal.
